title: A routine reorder that fails to save is undone with no word
what: In Edit routine, tapping Move up or Move down shows the new order at once. If the save fails, the screen quietly reloads the old order: no message and no Try again, so the member thinks it was saved or sees the order jump back for no reason.
expected: A failed reorder says so like every other save on this screen ('Couldn't save your last change. It is still shown here.' with Try again), as the file's own header promises (RP-15).
fix_line: Send the reorder through the screen's save helper so a failure shows Try again

title: A routine rename saved on leaving can fail with no word
what: When the member types a new routine name and leaves Edit routine by the back gesture or a tab switch, the name is saved on the way out. If that save fails the error is thrown away, so the routine keeps its old name and the member is never told.
expected: A rename that could not be saved is told to the member (or kept and retried), as the header says every save is awaited and a failed one says so.
fix_line: Report or retry a failed rename on leaving instead of swallowing it
